name: TagField
summary: A box where people type free tags: Enter or a comma adds the text as a tag, each tag has a remove button, and optional suggestions show under the box.
useWhen: People add their own words as a list of values, such as tags on a post, keywords or email domains
Any text is a valid value, with suggestions from words used before
Pasting a list separated by commas or lines should become many values at once
avoidWhen: The values must come from a fixed list
Long text or sentences, not short words

onValueChange.description: Called with the new string[] after an add or a removal.

suggestions.description: Suggested tags as ListBox items (an array of { value, label } or groups). The control becomes an ARIA 1.2 combobox with list autocomplete; tags already added are not suggested; choosing one adds its label.

max.description: The most tags. Text past it is not added and the status says so.

size.description: Box height at one line from size.control (28, 32, 44px at default density). Tags are size.control.xs high; the box grows a line at a time.

shape.description: default: the style's control radius (a pill in Studio and Desk). pill: always fully round; best for one line.

invalid.description: The danger border and aria-invalid. Inside a Field it follows the Field's error.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the control; remove buttons aria-disabled. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: Tags show without remove buttons; the control is read only. A dashed border.

required.description: aria-required on the control. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

removeLabel.description: The name of each remove button. Arabic default: حذف الوسم <tag>.

formatRemoved.description: The words read once after a removal. Arabic default: تم حذف الوسم <tag>.

name.description: Submits each tag under this name in a form, one hidden input per tag.

placeholder.description: A hint in the empty control, a verb plus a noun: Add a tag. Never the only label.

a11y.role: The control is a text input, named by the Field label. With suggestions it is an ARIA 1.2 combobox (aria-autocomplete list, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant) and the popup holds a ListBox named like the field. The tags are a list (role list and listitem) named like the field; each remove button is a CloseButton named Remove tag <tag>. Not modal.
a11y.focus: The control is the one tab stop; remove buttons are reached with Backspace and the arrow keys (tabindex -1). After a removal focus moves to the next tag, else the one before, else the control. With suggestions focus stays in the control.

keys.Enter: Adds the typed text as a tag, or the highlighted suggestion; with an empty control it does what the form does
keys.Comma: Adds the typed text as a tag (the comma and the Arabic comma ،)
keys.Backspace: On an empty control, focuses the last tag's remove button. On a remove button, removes that tag
keys.Delete: On a remove button, removes that tag
keys.ArrowLeft: With the caret at the start, moves to the last tag; between tags, to the one before. In right to left layouts this is ArrowRight
keys.ArrowRight: Between tags, to the next one, and past the last back to the control. In right to left layouts this is ArrowLeft
keys.Home: On a remove button, moves to the first tag
keys.End: On a remove button, moves back to the control
keys.ArrowDown: With suggestions: opens them, then moves to the next suggestion
keys.ArrowUp: With suggestions: moves to the previous suggestion. Escape closes the suggestions

a11y.announce: Each removal is read once from a polite status (Removed tag design; Arabic تم حذف الوسم design). A duplicate and the max are read the same way (design is already added). The status empties first, so the same words are read again.
notes: Splitting and duplicates come from @the-system/shared tags.ts: the comma, the Arabic comma and new lines split; parts are trimmed; two tags are the same when their normalize() forms match (case, accents, Arabic diacritics, tatweel and alef forms ignored).
Pasting text with a separator adds every part at once; a single line pastes as typed text.

Every remove button has its own name (Remove tag design), never a bare Close (WCAG 2.4.6, 4.1.2). Remove buttons are 24px targets (size.target-min, WCAG 2.5.8) and keep the close icon, never color alone.
The suggestions popup is portaled into a Theme copied from the field's Theme and is its own root carrying data-part popup, as the Combobox popup is.
IME composition: Enter that confirms a composition never adds a tag.

Contract: the root is read as a field, not an overlay (no trigger): the popup holds no tab stop. data-state open and closed is on the popup root only. Backspace is checked on the one case control as focus-moves.
Disabled: the control is natively disabled and the tag list carries aria-disabled, so the faded tags read as unavailable (WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive components).

en.label: A plural noun in a Field label: Tags, Keywords.
en.placeholder: A verb plus a noun: Add a tag.
en.hint: Say how to add: Press Enter or type a comma to add a tag.
en.tags: Short words, as people write them.
en.error: Say what to do: Add at least one tag.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: الوسوم.
ar.hint: اضغط Enter أو اكتب فاصلة لإضافة وسم.

react.behavior: hand built; suggestions on radix:Popover (Root, Anchor, Content) with ListBox virtualFocus; tags.ts from @the-system/shared
react.note: Sources Figma-Killer-2 TagPill/ and AddablePropertyField/ were not reachable in the lane session; the box follows the Combobox field, the tags Chip, the popup the list family popup.

angular.behavior: hand built with cdk:overlay and the shared tags.ts

native.behavior: hand built: a wrapping row of tags and a TextInput

styles.studio: The box is the Input box: a transparent pill with the control border, the glow and the ring while anything inside has focus. Tags are overlay-10 pills with a ghost CloseButton. The popup is the Studio menu surface.
styles.desk: The same box and tags. The suggestions popup is the Desk menu glass; the lit row is the yellow primary fill (the Desk ListBox recipe).
styles.neutral: Tokens only: the Neutral control radius and border, the Neutral menu surface.

mistakes.wrong: A remove button named Close or Remove
mistakes.right: Remove tag design: each button names its tag (built in)

mistakes.wrong: Adding Design and design as two tags
mistakes.right: Duplicates dropped, case and diacritic insensitive, and announced (built in)
Enter, the comma and the Arabic comma, and pasted lists (built in)

mistakes.wrong: A TagField for values that must be in a list
Removing a tag silently and dropping focus to the page
mistakes.right: The status says it once and focus moves to the next tag (built in)
